verdict.rationale: The broadcasts API lets developers 'review broadcast history', and the product attributes revenue to emails and flows in-app. However, nothing shows that campaign or flow performance metrics (opens, clicks, conversions, revenue) can be exported through the API. Missing for 10: documented campaign/broadcast stats endpoints with performance fields, flow/workflow/sequence performance metrics via API, API access to revenue attribution data, warehouse/export or dashboard integration guidance, independent corroboration.
